description: Checks a company or facility name against the MORVS U.S. Forced Labor Company Register: every organisation named on the DHS UFLPA Entity List or in a CBP withhold release order or finding, the Consolidated Screening List (Commerce, Treasury) rows that match one of those names exactly, and issuer relationships a US-listed company states in its own SEC filing. Matching is exact on the register's name key (case, accent, punctuation and legal-suffix insensitive) or on a source-stated or reviewed alias (DHS "also known as" / "formerly known as", CBP "a/k/a"); there is no fuzzy, family-name or transliteration match, and several matching entities are returned as separate candidates, never merged. Each match carries its direct records, one per source row, with the list's own action, status and date, the source URL, the row locator and the snapshot date; with include_related (default true) it also carries filing-stated issuer relationships, which never extend an action to a parent. UFLPA listing, a CBP order or finding, and an export-control or sanctions row are separate actions under separate laws, and a non-match is not a clearance finding. Organisations only; queries shaped like a personal name are not run.

include_related.description: Include issuer relationships stated in SEC filings (parent or subsidiary); default true. A relationship never extends an action.

name.description: Company or facility name or stated alias, e.g. Needle Craft Ltd or XPCC; case, punctuation and legal suffixes ignored, no partial match; 2-120 characters.

name: forced_labor_company_check
title: Check Forced Labor Register Company
